symptom: `create configuration 'Staging'` on testdata/testapp-views (Mendix 11.14.0) → `refusing to write unit …: 3 element id(s) are used more than once` held by Settings$OpenTelemetryConfiguration / …LogsConfiguration / …TracesConfiguration; the same statement succeeded on the 11.13 and 11.6 fixtures
cause: newServerConfiguration built a new configuration by shallow-copying the first sibling and deleting only its top-level $ID. On 11.12+ a Studio Pro-saved configuration carries a nested OpenTelemetry part (Model SDK: openTelemetry introduced 11.12.0, tracing deleted 11.12.0) with $IDs on the part and its Logs/Traces children, so the copy put each id in the unit twice and the duplicate-id guard refused the write
insight: Check the subject before trusting a green real run: a blank `mxcli new` 11.14.0 app stores `OpenTelemetry = null`, so the unfixed build creates a configuration there without complaint and `mx check` = 0 errors proves nothing — only a configuration Studio Pro has saved carries the nested part. On testapp-views the fixed build's `mx check` error list is identical to the unmodified baseline. Cloning a template needs a DEEP copy with a fresh $ID per nested storage object, not just the top-level one; the shallow copy also aliased the sibling's sub-documents into the new one. newLanguage uses the same shallow-copy shape but a Texts$Language has no nested elements, so it is unaffected — check the type's children before copying that pattern elsewhere. Found while replaying a describe-emitted `create or modify configuration` for a new name (mendixlabs/mxcli#131 work)
